records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Freight revenues increased 4% during the first quarter of 2023 compared to 2022, resulting from higher fuel surcharge revenues and core pricing gains, partially offset by negative mix of traffic and lower volume.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Freight revenues increased 4% in the quarter compared to the same period in 2022 driven by a 6% increase in average revenue per car (ARC), partially offset by a 1% decline in volume.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The Company reported earnings of $2.67 per diluted share on net income of $1.6 billion and an operating ratio of 62.1% in the first quarter of 2023 compared to earnings of $2.57 per diluted share on net income of $1.6 billion and an operating ratio of 59.4% for the first quarter of 2022.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The ARC increase was driven by higher fuel surcharge revenues and core pricing gains, partially offset by negative mix of traffic (for example, a relative decrease in forest products shipments, which have a higher ARC).

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The increased costs more than offset the higher revenues, producing operating income of $2.3 billion, a 3% decrease from first quarter of 2022.
